title: Privacy: readers of the store's record do not check that it predates an erase
evidence: RecordStore.readable (ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/RecordStore+Readable.swift) is the one read of the record outside the store, nil while predatesErase; myData, plan and topics read through it, the store's own pins, marks and units read heldData. applyInTurn refuses while predatesErase; the lab import and document save too. Checks: ios/scripts/recordstore-access.test.ts (no read of recordJSON, drawn or heldData outside the listed RecordStore files) and ios/HealthRoadmapTests/PredatesEraseReadersTests.swift. US-25 AC16f, AC16g, AC21
